name: Natukodi Pulusu
instructions: 1. Marinate the country chicken with turmeric, salt, and ginger-garlic paste for at least 30 minutes. 2. Prepare a fine paste by grinding poppy seeds, dry coconut, and spices. 3. Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed vessel, add whole spices and curry leaves. 4. Sauté onions and green chilies until golden brown. 5. Add tomatoes and cook until soft, then stir in the marinated chicken and sear until moisture evaporates. 6. Add chili powder, coriander powder, and the prepared coconut-poppy seed paste. 7. Pour enough water to submerge the chicken and simmer on low heat until the meat is tender and the oil separates. 8. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with steamed rice or Ragi Sangati.
description: Natukodi Pulusu is a signature dish from Telangana, known for its spicy and bold flavors. It is traditionally prepared during village festivities and family gatherings, showcasing the rustic culinary heritage of the region.
